author: Bin im Garten
why: Bare fingers stretching a green rubber dam over a dental phantom head with a clamp on a molar: the pre-clinical dental skill students practise on manikins before treating patients.
cropNote: Centre crop keeps the phantom's nose and the dam-covered mouth with the clamped teeth and two fingers holding the dam; a blurred handout is at the right edge, no legible text.

commonsFile: Facial plastic surgeon wearing surgical loupes and headlight during an operating room procedure.jpg
author: BalikianFacialPlasticSurgery
why: Close-up of a surgeon in mask, surgical loupes and headlight mid-operation: the working view of operative medicine.
cropNote: Crop keeps the green mask, the eye behind the loupes and the round headlight lamp filling the right half; no text, no patient visible.

author: Monirb
why: A nursing simulation ward: hospital beds with manikin patients, curtains and wall monitors, the practice space where nursing students rehearse bedside care.
cropNote: Crop keeps the row of blue-blanketed beds with a manikin in the nearest one and wall-mounted monitors; monitor screens are tiny and no numbers or words are legible.

commonsFile: Tissue processing - Stained and mounted slides in the ubiquitous 20-slide folder.jpg
author: Ed Uthman
why: A tray of stained tissue sections mounted on slides, ready for microscopy: the histology bench work named in the programme.
cropNote: Crop keeps two rows of pink and purple stained slides on a dark tray; handwritten labels are tiny and illegible at 480 px.

commonsFile: Solutions of organic substances for NMR analysis.jpg
author: Ryabitskii
why: A rack of test tubes of coloured organic solutions prepared for NMR analysis: the sample-preparation step of instrumental and spectral analysis.
cropNote: Crop keeps the row of yellow, green and amber solutions in glass tubes against a dark background; no text.
